note: Each event's own text on the club site (assets/site.js), keyed "<date>|<title>" exactly as on the schedule. summary: one line for the cards and the list; body: paragraphs for the event's page; after the date, recap_summary and recap take their place; full_page: a link to the event's info page under msclub/. Events without an entry just show their details.

2027-03-05|STEAM Day Somerset 2027.summary: Help eighth graders explore science at SCC. Counts as an MSSE activity.
body: STEAM Day brings eighth graders from area schools to SCC for hands-on activities in science, technology, engineering, arts, and math. Students explore new ideas, meet educators and professionals, and see where their interests might take them.
MSSE scholars: working STEAM Day counts as one of the 4 activities you need each semester.
